A dairy brand built by 36 lakh farmers pushed its turnover past Rs 1 lakh crore in FY 2025-26. That was an 11% rise on a Rs 90,000 crore base the year before.

Rather than dealing with each farmer one by one, Amul groups small milk producers into village-level societies. Much of the money shoppers pay is sent back to those farmers.
